title: This is why I have officially stopped caring about Reddit game dev communities
author: PoopsMcScoots
selftext:
I’m not stupid and I know these things are kiss asses, but I always try to get genuine feedback and ask for pushback, because I actually am working on things.

But JFC, are people on Reddit insufferable trying to discuss anything at all.

I just can’t do it anymore with people in the community.

It’s a giant toxic sludge puddle and the most innocuous of questions end ends up being a fucking rabbit hole of arguing with assholes who are deliberately missing your point.

And then they’ll jump all over you cackling, and down voting.

I’m just so fucking done with it.
